posts.cooked: I prefer over-sized, myself. Easier to play (flip), easier to read, and thematically more entertaining. (That big card really stands out on the table!) posts.name: VisforYoshi
posts.cooked: I can see both sides, Even though I have Sentinel Sidekick, I still like using the Damage counters, and I find it easier with the oversized cards to have the damage and see the card (especially with high HP villains). It's also easier to randomly select a vilain with the oversized, because you just fan them out, and have somebody pick one of them at random. But the small ones are easier to carry, and you need less table space for them as well. I've only played about 2 games with oversized villain cards, but I personally like them more because my friends like reading the cards, and the oversized ones should prevent people from having to pass it around

posts.name: grysqrl
posts.cooked: I go back and forth. I usually end up running the villain in most games. The small cards are nice because then I can have the picture card on the table with HP as a placeholder for everyone else and the rules card closer to me so I don't have to read upside-down. The oversized cards are nice because they're easier for other people at the table to see and (especially for newer players who can get distracted by al the minions) are a good reminder of the primary goal.
